name: Natsuiro ~Hoshifuru Kohan no Natsuyasumi~
original_name: なついろ ～星降る湖畔の夏休み～
source:
After the death of his father, Naoki, the protagonist, came back to the hometown he was born after a long time to visit his mother's grave. 

At the village owned by his father, he meets four girls, and his interaction with them will change his mind and heart little to little...

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=32365]Getchu.com[/url]]
translation:
父亲去世后，主人公直树时隔多年回到自己的出生地，前往母亲墓前祭拜。

在父亲拥有的村庄里，他遇见了四名少女。与她们的交流将一点一点改变他的想法与内心…

[翻译自[url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=32365]Getchu.com[/url]]
